name: tfg-pgim
description: Plataforma de gestión de restaurantes multi-sucursal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @pgim/shared" "npm run dev -w @pgim/api" "npm run dev -w @pgim/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pgim/shared && npm run build -w @pgim/api && npm run build -w @pgim/web
